body:
## Proposed bounded successor;execution not approved

Extends A/B implementing mandates and preserves their proposal hashes. Owner supplied autonomous engineering intent,but explicitly requires matching new approval. No wildcard/global governance change.

Scope mandate/reports/2026-10-29-beginner-engineering-umbrella-scope.json SHA-256 ac396237dc2eb9aa06c22e69aba44f07d347dd7b8789a731e048e4a2673f33d5;plan LF SHA-256 76de9c7ac39bb7321f38931fafe7736e623773ec855b63fcddc32e68d9e0cc29;source baseline c5b5efbed70fea5ea8fff03c5cbdb307b84d133dc757012ba13ce4b11bd93c44;exact source allowlist fingerprint 42790ff07be71ec71a2d09759deedce4b5110783a3a41098d95c391f76fd445d. Baseline HEAD 39b6e90688c38fa0ec9b04289d02e751e94639fd;capture-only governance commits may advance HEAD only with all frozen inputs unchanged.

## Delegation and sequencing
One matching approval opens all four engineering tasks in the linked plan. Agent may autonomously fix/test/minimally refactor/review/local-commit within20exact source paths and146fixed runtime paths;single writer per file/shared register. New dependency,file,identity,cost or protected change requires new matching scope. No parent approval or readiness inherited.

## Existing GateC
Keep MND-20261027-004 unchanged. Only synthetic protocol/validator preparation here;actual rehearsal,privacy/consent/storage and current C lifecycle approval stay separate. Historical47-file/106test evidence must remain at its original revision;new current-governance validation is additive.

## External boundaries
No real provider/credential,DB,OS/ACL,learner session,publication or readiness authority. Existing A live permissions remain separate and blocked by fresh quota/retention/data-transfer/oracle evidence;the Umbrella does not silently satisfy them. No new dependencies or broad default test scripts. Independent review unavailable remains BLOCKED.

## Rollback
Stop;retain journal/receipts/history;review local reverts of this mandate source only;exact owned synthetic runtime cleanup,never broad deletion or accounting reset.
